title: Health Resort west wing office room 104 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 104 of the Health Resort West wing on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing office room 104 key (W104 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing office room 104.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- In a locker inside the smaller building at the power plant

- Inside a house in the village. It spawns in a shoe box on a bed frame.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Room 104 on the first floor of the west wing in the health resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose Loot (Meds, Currency)
- 1 x LEDX spawn
- Blue keycard spawn location
